prerequisites: Admission to the Master's in Telecommunication Engineering studies.
For company internships via educational agreement, the student must meet the conditions outlined in article 4 of the University of Oviedo's External Internship Regulations.
syllabus_topics: Performing internships in companies in the sector, technology or research centers, or research groups of the University of Oviedo.

assessment_methods.method: Assessment by the tutor of the host institution

assessment_rules: Assessment will be based on the reports submitted by the student, the evaluation by the host entity's tutor, and the follow-up conducted by the academic tutor. The academic tutor will evaluate the developed internships by completing the corresponding final assessment report.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (Telecomunicación, Gijón)
degree: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación
